description: Save, change or remove one company annual-report account rule after the owner has chosen: rule_type 'cash_flow_category' (operating | investing | financing; any balance-sheet account, e.g. a 24xx account from cash_flow_account_reviews) or 'liability_classification' (current | non_current; Kohustused accounts only). account_id is the account number. remove=true deletes the rule. Writes the accounting-rules store; re-run generate_annual_report_data afterwards.

account_id.description: Account number in the active company's chart (e.g. 2430)

remove.description: true deletes the account's rule instead of saving one

rule_type.description: Which annual-report rule table to edit

value.description: cash_flow_category: operating | investing | financing; liability_classification: current | non_current. Omit with remove=true

name: save_annual_report_account_rule
title: Save Annual-Report Account Rule
